target_customer: Industrial and chemical manufacturers and distributors, from a few million to billions of dollars in sales, that price and quote thousands of products
problem: Most customer requests are still priced by hand: reps search the catalog, check past prices and chase approvals while the customer keeps shopping.
business_model: B2B SaaS on top of customer ERP, CRM and email
product_category: AI pricing, quoting and sales agents for manufacturing

founders.name: Malay Shah
prior_employers: Specialty chemicals companies (operations and sales roles in China, Germany and the US)
education: NC State, chemical engineering and economics

founders.name: Andrew Bass
prior_employers: Series A mobility startup (revenue optimization, later acquired)

technical_complexity.rationale: Agents must read emails and map requests to catalog, cost and past deal data in ERPs, which is integration heavy; LLM tooling was available in 2024.

defensibility.rationale: ERP integration and manufacturer specific pricing data create some lock-in, but the approach is open to copy by quoting startups.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Later AI quoting entrants appeared in 2025 and 2026; no incumbent action against Poka found.

market_need_then: Manual pricing is slow in industrial sales; a vendor survey in 2025 says six in ten manufacturers rank AI pricing tools a top goal (vendor source, later than founding).

branding.domain_note: Uses pokalabs.com with the Labs suffix; poka.io belongs to a different industrial software company.

identity.voice_and_tone: direct, keeps human judgment in control

branding.brand_signature: Tagline 'Good judgment. Built into every quote.'

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand; shares its name with an unrelated industrial software firm, Poka.

pivots.from: Production planning and operations software for chemical manufacturers (YC launch post)
pivots.to: AI agents for pricing, quoting and sales at industrial manufacturers

outcome_analysis: Poka Labs is active with a small team and a customer logo list that includes Thermo Fisher Scientific. It moved from production scheduling for chemical makers to pricing and quoting agents. Funding is unclear, so the stage of traction cannot be judged. Founders have chemicals domain experience and Harvard MBAs, which fits the target market, but no outcome has been reported.
notes: Funding unverified: aggregators give conflicting figures (PitchBook 500K total, Crunchbase snippet about 2.5M, CB Insights a seed dated 2024-09-20 with Transpose Platform). None confirmed by a company or press source, so no round recorded. No competitor source dated near the batch found; the AI quoting entrants found (Uptool, Forgepoint) are 2025 or 2026. Founders met during HBS MBAs per YC page. No outcome news found. YC launch post only seen in search results, not opened. Completeness pass: the seed dated 2024-09-20 rests on CB Insights alone; amount left null because PitchBook (500K total) and Crunchbase (about 2.5M) conflict.
